page_title: AUX 3-4 LIL | Auxerre v Lille 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Auxerre quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+7' A sweet pass finds Danny Namaso (Auxerre) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the top left corner. Berke Ozer is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Auxerre have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+7' Auxerre enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90+3' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) duly receives a yellow card.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Kevin Danois comes off the pitch to be replaced by Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre).
88' Oussama El Azzouzi (Auxerre) makes an ugly tackle on his opponent and is sent off by the referee!
88' Romain Perraud (Lille) makes an ugly challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
88' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) is booked.

86' 3 - 4 It's a goal! Benjamin Andre (Lille) makes it 3:4. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Romain Perraud and planted his close-range header low into the middle of the goal. Donovan Leon was helpless.
86' Felix Correia (Lille) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
84' The referee signals a substitution. Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) is brought on as a substitute for Ethan Mbappe.
83' 3 - 3 Goal! Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Berke Ozer into right side of the goal.
83' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) is going to take the penalty!
82' Felix Correia (Lille) has tested the patience of referee Jeremie Pignard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
82' Felix Correia (Lille) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. PENALTY to Auxerre! Great chance to score.
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Fredrik Oppegard as he is replaced by Gideon Mensah (Auxerre).

80' 2 - 3 Soriba Diaoune (Lille) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Donovan Leon is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top right corner. The score is 2:3.
77' 2 - 2 Goal! Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the bottom left corner. It's 2:2.
75' Bruno Genesio prepares a substitution. Olivier Giroud is replaced by Soriba Diaoune (Lille).
75' Felix Correia (Lille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
75' Here comes a substitution. Thomas Meunier is given a rest as he is replaced by Tiago Santos (Lille).
74' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
71' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
71' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
68' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
66' 2 - 1 What bad luck! Chancel Mbemba (Lille) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 2:1.
63' Here is a change. Josue Casimir is going off and Christophe Pelissier gives the last tactical orders to Assane Diousse (Auxerre).
63' Lille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
60' Clement Akpa (Auxerre) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
59' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.

57' 1 - 1 Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner kick and scores with a great header into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:1.
57' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
57' Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Auxerre get a corner.
55' Unbelievable miss! Sekou Mara (Auxerre) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar!
55' Now Auxerre have a corner.
55' Lamine Sy (Auxerre) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball goes out for a corner. Auxerre can continue in their attacking effort.
52' Auxerre win a corner.
49' Aissa Mandi (Lille) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Clement Akpa (Auxerre) was quite harsh and Jeremie Pignard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' Auxerre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
47' Lamine Sy (Auxerre) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Auxerre comes to nothing.

47' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Berke Ozer pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. Auxerre force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
46' Half-time substitution. Osame Sahraoui will not participate anymore and Chancel Mbemba (Lille) is coming on.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Christophe Pelissier probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Rudy Matondo. He is replaced by Sekou Mara (Auxerre).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) serves up a nice cross, but Berke Ozer punches the ball away.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
42' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
42' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Lille have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Nathan Ngoy (Lille) takes out his opponent with an awful tackle and is shown a red card by the referee!
37' Auxerre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
35' Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
33' A pass from Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) is intercepted by Berke Ozer and the move breaks down.
32' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
29' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) will deliver the corner kick.
29' Romain Perraud (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It will be a corner kick for Lille.
29' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
27' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
25' Great teamplay by Lille as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
25' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) commits a rough challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for an infringement.
24' A quickly taken corner by Auxerre.
23' A great run from Josue Casimir (Auxerre) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
17' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Josue Casimir (Auxerre) for his blatant foul.
17' A corner kick by Auxerre is thwarted by the well prepared Berke Ozer (Lille).

16' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper. The ball goes out of play. Auxerre are awarded a corner kick.
16' The ball goes out of play. Auxerre are awarded a corner kick.
15' The Auxerre players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
13' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
13' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul.
9' 0 - 1 Goal! Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:1.

7' Auxerre slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lille will kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard will supervise the game today.
